profile_text.body:
Hut 8 Corp. is a Miami, Florida based public company traded under the ticker HUT. On its own site the company describes itself as owning, operating, and scaling purpose-built businesses that acquire, deploy, and monetize specialized hardware for next-generation, energy-intensive technologies, and says that through this portfolio it provides direct exposure to markets created by transformative technologies such as AI and Bitcoin mining.

The site also states that Hut 8 has fully commercialized a 1 GW Beacon Point AI data center campus with a second 352 MW IT lease, bringing campus-level base-term contract value to $19.6 billion.

The company's record lists no tracked AI products, no MCP servers, and no lawsuits. Its law exposure is recorded in Florida, with a count of 96.
